subject: Re: Helix.ai Dedicated load test — pricing & commit options
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@helix.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@helix.ai>, Tim Burke <tim.burke@benchco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Results from Dedicated load test + pricing ask

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for running the dedicated pool soak with our traffic pattern last week. Tim attached a short TPS extract and the dashboard snapshot we captured. High level notes:
- Stable 95th latency at 220ms with 4x batching enabled
- Peak sustained throughput ~1,800 TPS for 30m, then throttled to 1,450 TPS under cold-start conditions
- KV-cache hit pattern suggests ~22% token reuse on typical user flows

We’re evaluating committing to a dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA A100-class equivalent) for our inference layer. Before we lock anything down, can you give:
1) Sizing guidance — how many GPUs to guarantee 2,500 TPS sustained with 99th pct latency < 400ms?
2) Pricing buckets for 12mo vs 24mo commits (and any up-front vs monthly options)
3) Any benchmark artifacts you need from our side to finalize the proposal

Goal: get a committed pricing term we can push to procurement this week. Attached: helix_tps_report_0224.csv and dashboard snapshot.

Cheers,
Laura Chen
Platform Lead — Helix.ai

--- Attached: helix_tps_report_0224.csv (CSV, 84KB); dedicated_dashboard_snapshot.png (PNG, 420KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@helix.ai>
Cc: Tim Burke <tim.burke@benchco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Results from Dedicated load test + pricing ask

Laura —

Really useful data, thanks. Quick answers up front, and I’ll loop in pricing/ops for firm numbers:
- Sizing: based on the pattern Tim sent, to target 2,500 TPS sustained with 99th < 400ms we recommend a 6-GPU pool (A100-class) with 2 GPUs reserved for burst capacity (effectively 8-GPU headroom) and continuous batching enabled. This assumes the same request mix; if session lengths increase we’ll need +1 GPU per ~15% session-length increase.
- Pricing: I don’t have the final legal pricing in-line — I can get you a 12mo vs 24mo matrix by EOD tomorrow. We typically offer 10–18% discount for 12mo and 18–28% for 24mo depending on committed throughput and payment terms.
- Artifacts: the CSV is perfect. If you can also share a 72-hour capture of tail-latency traces (sampled) that will let us validate cold-start behavior.

I’ll put Marissa and Rafael on copy; they’ll propose formal commit tiers and an MOP. Can we schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow to walk the pricing matrix?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Helix.ai — load test summary + ask (pricing & commit sizing)

Team —

Quick summary from Helix bench (see attached CSV): sustained peaks ~1.8k TPS, cold periods drop to ~1.45k TPS; latency profile mostly healthy. Customer desire: commit pricing for Dedicated GPU pool to guarantee 2.5k TPS sustained and keep 99th < 400ms. They’re close to signing if we can give a predictable sizing + pricing with a short canary window.

Questions for pricing/ops:
- Confirm sizing: I suggested 6 GPUs with 2-GPU burst buffer (8 GPU effective). Confirm throughput per GPU assumptions and whether the burst model is billable as reserved or metered.
- Discount bands: propose 12mo & 24mo bands (percent discount off list) tied to a commit in vGPU-hours or token throughput. Helix prefers a 12mo option but will consider 24mo for better pricing.
- SLA/guarantee language: what CTAs do we need to include for <400ms 99th? Can we offer an SLO-backed credit or only operational best-effort?

Attached: helix_tps_report_0224.csv (from customer). I’ve also pasted the HubSpot deal below.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HLX-2026-47

If we can get a draft by EOD I’ll send to procurement.

Thanks — Karthik

--- Attached: helix_tps_report_0224.csv

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Helix.ai — load test summary + ask (pricing & commit sizing)

Karthik / team —

See proposed pricing and sizing below (high level). I included assumptions so we’re aligned before we share with Helix.

Sizing assumptions:
- Baseline inference profile = 1.8k TPS sustained across test; target buffer to 2.5k TPS = 39% headroom
- Throughput per A100-equivalent GPU under our runtime with 4x batching ~= 400 TPS sustained
- Recommended configuration: 7 reserved GPUs (primary pool) + 1 hot stand-by (for fast burst/cold-start smoothing) => 8 GPUs total reserved for commit. This maps to ~3,200 TPS steady-state with headroom.

Pricing bands (list price = $X per GPU/month — redacted internal list):
- 12mo commit: 8 GPU reserved = list * 8 * (1 - 0.12) (12% discount) — monthly billing option available; 1.5% additional off for prepay annual
- 24mo commit: 8 GPU reserved = list * 8 * (1 - 0.22) (22% discount) — 3% additional off for prepay annual
- Throughput Surcharge: if sustained >3.2k TPS for >72h we move to metered overage at a reduced rate (applies rarely)

SLA/SLO note:
- We can provide an operational SLO: 99th < 400ms with an escalation & on-call support path.
- For financial credits tied to SLO breaches we require a canary 30-day ramp and a 6-month minimum commit before credits apply. This is to avoid gaming during initial tuning.

Deliverables to send Helix with proposal:
- Pricing spreadsheet (attached: redwood_pricing_draft_HLX.xlsx)
- MOP (canary plan + rollback triggers) — I’ll draft and share
- Baseline bench artifact (we’ll certify their CSV against our trace sample)

I recommend we present the 12mo with 12% discount + 1.5% prepay to start (Helix preference). If they push for deeper discount we can negotiate term length / commit size.

-Marissa
Sr. Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

--- Attached: redwood_pricing_draft_HLX.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@helix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@helix.ai>, Tim Burke <tim.burke@benchco.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Helix.ai — proposed commit & next steps (HLX-2026-47)

Laura —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is our proposed commitment for your review:
- Configuration: 8 reserved GPUs (7 primary + 1 hot standby) — maps to ~3.2k TPS steady-state with headroom for bursts
- Pricing: 12mo commit at 12% discount off list, monthly billing. Option to prepay annual for an extra 1.5% off.
- Canary: 30-day ramp, instrumentation checklists, and a rollback trigger if 99th > 400ms for more than 24 continuous hours during the canary.
- Overages: metered at reduced rate if sustained >3.2k TPS >72h.

Attached: redwood_pricing_draft_HLX.xlsx, helix_tps_report_0224.csv. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HLX-2026-47

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Helix confirms preferred term (12mo vs 24mo) and payment cadence — target: EOD Mon
2) Redwood provides MOP + contract redline — target: Wed
3) Canary kickoff — target: within 7 days of signed order

Can you confirm if procurement wants a formal SoW or PO-based start? If you’re good with 12mo with prepay, I can get Legal drafting the order.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

--- Attached: redwood_pricing_draft_HLX.xlsx; helix_tps_report_0224.csv

From: Laura Chen <laura@helix.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@helix.ai>, Tim Burke <tim.burke@benchco.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Helix.ai — proposed commit & next steps (HLX-2026-47)

Karthik / team —

Thanks — procurement reviewed and we’re comfortable moving forward with the 12mo commit at the 12% discount. Procurement asked if Redwood can stretch to 10% + 1.5% prepay (effectively 11.5%) in recognition of our timing; they also requested SOC2 evidence and an updated MOP that includes a data-retention/retention-of-logs entry.

Requested changes (procurement):
- Discount: counter to 11.5% effective on the 12mo term (12% is OK but asking if there’s flexibility)
- SOC2: can you provide an attestation (PDF) or pointer to our compliance pack?
- MOP: include specific log-retention clause (90 days) and contact for audit requests

If you can get those items in the next 48h we’ll circulate the final PO for signature. Tim — we’ll keep you on the loop for the canary instrumentation.

Best,
Laura Chen
Platform Lead — Helix.ai
